## Design Settings » Content Boxes & Backgrounds
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046625

## Content Boxes & Backgrounds
This article reviews the available settings to edit the Content Boxes, which are used across the website. To edit these settings navigate to:
Settings
Design Settings
General
Additional Design Settings
Content Boxes & Backgrounds.
